blurb: Blooma offers doula support throughout pregnancy, birth, and postpartum, including birth doulas, postpartum doulas, and companion care. They provide a variety of birth and new parent classes, as well as prenatal and postnatal movement classes such as yoga and barre. Private event space and studio rentals with optional instructor-led classes are also available.
extraNote: $120 travel fee for clients farther than 15 miles from studio · Cleaning fee may be charged if studio is not left tidy after private event · South Minneapolis studio location
